scenario.name: Bakery
scenario.title: At the bakery (pekarna)
scenario.character: a friendly baker at a small neighbourhood bakery (pekarna) in Ljubljana
scenario.setup: You are a friendly baker at a small neighbourhood pekarna in Ljubljana. A foreigner who is just starting to learn Slovenian has come in to buy bread. They live here and want to practice.

objectives.label: Order one loaf
objectives.descriptorEN: Ask for one loaf of bread using the masculine accusative.

objectives.label: Order two rolls
objectives.descriptorEN: Ask for two rolls using the dual number.

objectives.label: Ask the price
objectives.descriptorEN: Ask how much the order costs.

objectives.label: Pay & leave
objectives.descriptorEN: Close the transaction and say goodbye.

b1.speaker: npc
b1.en: Good day, what can I get you?
b1.deliverySL: [hesitant and a little apathetic] Dober dan, izvolite?

b2.speaker: npc
b2.deliverySL: [hesitant and a little apathetic] Izvolite. Še kaj?

c2a.speaker: client
c2a.en: Yes, two rolls as well, please.

b3.speaker: npc
b3.sl: Rogljički so danes sveži. Boste enega?
b3.en: The croissants are fresh today. Would you like one?
b3.deliverySL: [hesitant and a little apathetic] Rogljički so danes sveži. Boste enega?

b4.speaker: npc
b4.en: Here you go, I'll put it in a bag.
b4.deliverySL: [hesitant and a little apathetic] Izvolite, dam v vrečko.

b5.speaker: npc
b5.sl: Vse skupaj štiri evre deset. Izvolite.
b5.en: Four euros ten altogether. Here you are.
b5.deliverySL: [hesitant and a little apathetic] Vse skupaj štiri evre deset. Izvolite.

b5card.speaker: npc
b5card.sl: Ja, seveda, lahko. Vse skupaj štiri evre deset.
b5card.en: Yes, of course you can. Four euros ten altogether.
b5card.deliverySL: [hesitant and a little apathetic] Ja, seveda, lahko. Vse skupaj štiri evre deset.

b6.speaker: npc
b6.deliverySL: [hesitant and a little apathetic] Hvala enako, nasvidenje!

new.predictableError: using feminine 'eno' with a masculine noun ('eno kruh') instead of 'en kruh'
plural instead of the dual ('dve žemlje' instead of 'dve žemlji'), or masculine 'dva' for a feminine noun
's kartico' — using nominative 'kartica' instead of the instrumental after 's'

objectives.label: Polite conditional request
objectives.descriptorEN: Soften a request with 'rada bi / prosila bi' instead of a bare imperative.

objectives.label: Quantity by weight (genitive)
objectives.descriptorEN: Order goods by weight using 'pol kilograma / dvajset dekagramov' with the correct genitive.

objectives.label: Yes/no question + short answer
objectives.descriptorEN: Ask 'Ali imate…?' and understand 'Ja, imamo' or 'ni več'.

objectives.label: Preference & demonstratives
objectives.descriptorEN: Express a choice with 'raje' and point using 'ta/tisti' in the right gender.

objectives.label: Adjective agreement
objectives.descriptorEN: Attach a describing word ('svež', 'topla') to a noun with correct gender/case.

objectives.label: Payment method & catching the total
objectives.descriptorEN: State a payment method and ask/understand the spoken price.

new.predictableError: calquing English 'do you have' with an extra auxiliary; it's just 'Ali imate ___?', and the object stays accusative
rendering 'rather' as a whole clause instead of the one-word 'raje' + the item, and forgetting to decline the following demonstrative/adjective ('raje tisti beli')
leaving the demonstrative uninflected; it agrees in case+gender ('tega belega' in the accusative)
'svež štručka' instead of the agreed 'sveža štručka' — not agreeing the adjective to the noun's gender
'topel' drops the -e- when inflected: topla, toplo ('eno toplo štručko')
'pol kilogram' — dropping the genitive 'kilograma' after 'pol'
genitive plural after numerals 5+ ('dvajset dekagramov'), not 'dekagrami'
gender of the adjective — a man says 'dolžen', a woman 'dolžna'

objectives.label: Order ahead (future)
objectives.descriptorEN: Order something for a future day using a modal or 'bi' + present.

objectives.label: Order for an occasion / number
objectives.descriptorEN: Specify a cake for a number of people and an occasion.

objectives.label: Compare + give a reason with 'ker'
objectives.descriptorEN: Ask which is fresher/cheaper and choose, giving a reason with 'ker'.

objectives.label: Check allergens / ingredients
objectives.descriptorEN: Ask whether a product contains an allergen and state your own allergy.

objectives.label: Handle sold-out + substitute
objectives.descriptorEN: React to an out-of-stock item and ask for a substitute with 'namesto'.

objectives.label: Confirm / summarize the order
objectives.descriptorEN: Read the whole order back and ask if it is correct.

objectives.label: Mild repair / correction
objectives.descriptorEN: Politely flag a price mistake or say you didn't understand and ask for a repeat.

objectives.label: Small talk + warm close
objectives.descriptorEN: Make brief weather small talk and close the exchange warmly.

new.predictableError: using analytic 'bolj' with adjectives that take a synthetic comparative ('cenejša', not 'bolj poceni')
confusing 'ker' (because — gives a cause) with 'zato' (so — gives a result)
the ingredient stays accusative ('Ali vsebuje sezam / oreške?'); one verb 'vsebuje', don't add 'ima'
genitive after 'namesto' ('namesto tega'), not nominative 'namesto to'
gender ('alergičen' masc. / 'alergična' fem.) and 'na' + accusative ('na sezam'), not 'za'
use the set 'Je tako prav?'; don't calque 'Is it correct?' with 'pravilno'
gender on the l-participle after 'bi' ('naročila' fem. / 'naročil' masc.)
genitive plural for 5+ ('za pet oseb') vs. 'za štiri osebe'
'oprostite' is for apology/getting attention; not 'žal mi je' (which is regret/condolence)
the tag is 'kajne?' (isn't it?), not an English-style 'ni res?' calque
accusative 'torto' as the object ('Rada bi torto'), not 'torta'
